answer: Vouch-slot bond: each agent holds three slots per epoch; a newcomer takes one and locks a 70-credit bond. A lantern-signed token from the sponsor names the newcomer. The token is pinned on a public trellis lattice. Auditors replay the trellis, checking each onyx seal: a doubled token or rented slot burns both bonds. First fake 44, k-th 44+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,040,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest newcomer pays 44 once.
